limitations: Self-selected app-store reviews; not representative of all users.
Cancellation language is expressed intent, not observed churn; no revenue or causal impact is estimated.
Classification coverage: 500 records [K01] all completed [K02], 479 by model call [K03] and 21 by exact-text reuse [K04], so duplicates share one label.
Usability leads billing/support on area severity sum, so the recommendation also weighs mean severity and a single top issue; the margin is modest.
memo.recommendation: Under the baseline rule (priority_score = complaint_count x mean_severity = severity_sum), the generic "other.general" issue ranks first at 113 [C04], but it is not a product area. Among specific areas, usability has the highest severity sum at 139 [T03], while billing_support is second at 124 [T09] and is driven by free tier limits and paywall, the top specific issue at 109 [C08] from 41 complaints [C05]. I recommend billing/support, because it has higher mean severity (2.695652 [T10]) than usability (2.241935 [T04]); usability is the close alternative, with ads at 61 [C12]. This is self-selected historical review evidence and expresses intent only.

supporting_evidence.point: Free tier limits/paywall is the top specific issue by priority score (109) and has 41 complaints.
Generic dissatisfaction ranks first at 113 but is not actionable as a product area.
Billing_support severity sum is 124 across area records, with a higher mean severity than usability.

memo.title: Next-quarter focus: billing/support (free tier and paywall) leads the specific areas
